title: Chapter 2: At This Rate, You'll Never Be Able To Become The Kind Of Person Who Gets Taken Care Of, You Know? 2
content: I walked proudly toward my childhood friends like a Hollywood star on the red carpet.
“Hey, sorry to keep you waiting.”
Without obstruction, it took only a few seconds to reach them.
I put my stuff on my desk, raised my hand lightly, and greeted them. They nodded and spoke.
“Yeah, good morning, Kazu-kun!”
“Morning. You and those two are pretty energetic for early morning.”
“I’m not that energetic. Keeping up with their mood is tiring.”
“It’s from playing too many games. Also, you’re late as usual, sleepyhead.”
Arisa was as harsh as ever to me. Well, that’s just how she is.
Recently, with big changes even outside social games, I honestly appreciate that my childhood friends’ attitudes haven’t changed.
“A lot happened… huh? Setsuna, did you change shampoo? Your scent’s a bit different.”
“You noticed!? I did a shampoo commercial shoot yesterday! I got samples and tried them!”

I pointed out the slightly different scent, and Setsuna smiled happily and nodded. She seemed glad I noticed. I remembered reading somewhere that girls like it when others notice small changes, even childhood friends.
“I see. You’re doing idol stuff.”
“I really am an idol! But I’m happy… Kazu-kun notices right away. You really watch over me.”
“Of course. You’re someone precious who’ll support me for life. I’d be troubled if you got sick, so I always try to be careful.”
“Kazu-kun…”
Setsuna looked at me with moist eyes. Her cuteness and radiant aura clearly attracted attention even in this classroom.
As an idol, she charms many people and smiles, but she could feel the gazes on her here.
“Ah…”
“Your hair feels nice too. Maybe you should keep using this shampoo.”
I lightly stroked her head. It felt soft and fluffy. Her hair quality was good to begin with, but the shampoo seemed to suit her.
“Yeah… if you say so, I will. So, more…”
“Alright, alright… huh?”
As I was about to stroke her head more to fulfill her request, Arisa suddenly tugged on my blazer’s hem.
I looked over, and there was my silver-haired childhood friend avoiding eye contact and pinching my uniform with her fingertips.
“Arisa? What’s wrong?”
“…I was in that commercial too.”
Still avoiding eye contact, she said that. Her tone was blunt, but her cheeks were slightly red.
Seeing that, I immediately understood what this tsundere childhood friend wanted.
“Sorry, Arisa. I was slow to notice.”
I reached out and patted Arisa’s head. It was a bit of a hassle, but not a big deal.
Her silver-blonde hair was soft in a different way from Setsuna’s black hair, welcoming my palm.
“Mm… it’s fine… I don’t care…”
“You say that, but you look comfortable. You’ve always liked having your head patted, haven’t you?”
“That’s not true. I’m not a kid anymore…”
Even saying that, Arisa narrowed her eyes like a cat.
It was obvious she enjoyed it, but I didn’t point it out.
“Arisa, you’re being tricked… I have to save you…! My brain’s breaking…! Curse you, Kuzuhara Kuzuma…!”
Ignoring the voices of resentment drifting in the classroom, I continued talking with my childhood friends.
“By the way, about why I was late this morning—I got bothered by a weird guy.”
“A weird person?”
“Not that Ijuuin girl, right?”
Setsuna and Arisa simultaneously looked toward Ijuuin.
Suddenly, Ijuuin’s face turned bright red as she started making a fuss.
“H-hey!!! Setsuna-sama and Arisa-sama are looking at me!!! Is this a dream!? An illusion!? Himeno! Take a picture of this right now! Himeno!!!”
She was as high-energy as ever in the morning.
She had been glaring at me like she wanted to curse me just moments ago, but now she was acting like a spoiled child.
In reality, Setsuna and Arisa saw Ijuuin as a flashy, stalking weirdo.
Not knowing that, she happily frolicked. Sometimes ignorance is bliss.
“Honestly, that’s embarrassing. I’m troubled by the princess’s love for ‘Damenzu.’”
“That’s absolutely true… huh?”
While thinking that, I nodded to the voice behind me but quickly realized it wasn’t my childhood friends.
I looked toward the voice and saw a black-haired girl wearing a headdress, standing silently and expressionless.
“Um…”
“I’m Ichinose Himeno, Kuzuhara-sama. I transferred recently as the attendant and maid of Lady Reika.”
“Ichinose… oh, Ijuuin’s maid.”
It clicked when she introduced herself. She was the maid always with Ijuuin.
I had been distracted by Ijuuin’s strong personality and hadn’t noticed she was also a new transfer student.
She was wearing our school uniform now, but I probably didn’t recognize her because I remembered her in the maid outfit.
Feeling a bit guilty, I bowed sincerely to Ichinose. Unlike Ijuuin, I had no ill feelings toward this maid.
“Sorry for noticing late.”
“No worries. More importantly, I apologize for the trouble Lady Reika causes.”
“No, it’s not like that… well, actually it is.”
I tried to deny it, but I couldn’t. Being bothered every morning was true. I couldn’t deny it as a social courtesy.
“Hey, Himeno! Why are you talking to Kuzuhara? Get away now! You’ll catch the scum! And it’s unfair you’re so close to ‘Damenzu’! I want to talk to them too!”
She was yelling at me now. Not only noisy in appearance but also in behavior—what a pain.
“Himeno-san, Ijuuin said that, but aren’t you going to leave?”
“Yes. Honestly, being near Lady Reika is troublesome because she asks for so much. She’s like that at home too, so I want to be free at school.”
Such blunt honesty. It must be tough to keep up with that energy all the time. I’d hate it.
But as a maid, lacking loyalty like that is questionable.
…Well, it’s Ijuuin, so whatever.
“So she’s like that at home too…”

“Worse, actually. She smiles creepily at posters of Setsuna and the others plastered all over the walls and blasts ‘Damenzu’ songs loudly. It’s a kind of addiction. Lady Reika is overly energetic, so be careful.”
“Wow…”
“Because of that, I had to transfer here. She’s really hopeless.”
Her own maid was exposing Ijuuin’s hopeless private life.
I had suspected it, but it seemed serious. She was completely stuck in the swamp.
“That’s… unfortunate…”
“No, I’m used to it by now.”
Ichinose shook her head expressionlessly but I sensed some melancholy.
At least she seemed to bear a lot of worries despite being the same age.
“Still, it’s troublesome. Since Lady Reika won’t come near when ‘Damenzu’ or Kuzuhara are around, may I join you here?”
“I don’t mind. Are you okay with that, you two?”
“Sure.”
“After hearing that, there’s no way we’d chase her away…”
Though a bit flustered, I asked my childhood friends, who nodded immediately.
They’re idols and not shy, after all.
So, a gorgeous and splendid group formed here: two active idols, a high school maid, and a handsome guy.
From the outside, it looked like a harem, but I didn’t mind being surrounded by beautiful girls.
“Thanks. You saved me.”
“No problem. We help each other out.”
“Yes. By the way, Kazuma, your hands stopped. Pat their heads more.”
“Okay, okay.”
“Me too!”
“Got it, got it.”
Arisa urged me, and I patted both their heads again. Ichinose watched us with interest.
“You all get along well.”
“Well, we’ve known each other a long time. We plan to look after each other forever, so we’re closer than normal childhood friends. Right?”
“Of course! Kazu and I share a deeper bond and promise than anyone else! No one can tear us apart! If anyone tries, that person is… hehe…”
“I don’t think I’m close with Kazuma… I just can’t leave him alone because he’s careless… but I don’t want to end as just normal childhood friends. Ugh, I wish I could be more honest. I’m stupid…”
Both Setsuna and Arisa looked down, showing similar reactions that reflected their closeness.
The difference was Arisa blushed and mumbled something, while Setsuna smiled faintly.
It’s common, so no need to worry.
“Oh, right. About this morning, I got bothered by a flashy guy. He said he’s targeting the other ‘Damenzu’ members besides you two. He was pretty handsome, so be careful.”
“Okay, got it.”
“Understood.”
I reported what happened this morning, and they nodded obediently.
I probably didn’t need to say it, but I didn’t want the ‘Damenzu’ members to get caught by a weird guy.
The world is big; there might be scum trying to make them spend money.
(Well, the biggest problem now is still Ijuuin and her gang.)
I left the flashy senpai to Arisa and the others, but my own problem remained unresolved.
The fan club’s influence and hostility toward me were growing daily, and there was a risk of real harm.
It’s better to deal with trouble early before it spirals out of control.
But I don’t think they’ll be satisfied with half-measures.
After all, they’re all huge fans of ‘Damenzu.’ Idol otaku obsession is not to be underestimated.
“Are you troubled, Kuzuhara-sama?”
While lost in thought, Ichinose spoke. I guess it showed on my face.
The source of my worries was her mistress, but telling her would only trouble her.
I didn’t want to cause unnecessary concern.
“No, it’s nothing…”
I tried to say it was nothing, but stopped.
My gaze fell on the headdress on Ichinose’s head, expressionless like ice.
“…A maid, huh.”
Then I looked at my childhood friends.
Two outstandingly beautiful active idols were there.
They wore uniforms now, but as idols, they often wore various costumes and did gravure work recently.
Insight, discovery, and information combined like puzzle pieces, forming a picture in my mind.
“Kazu-kun?”
“Kazuma?”
“Sorry, something came up. I’ll step out for a bit.”
My childhood friends looked at me suspiciously as I stopped, but I excused myself and left.
Without hesitation, I crossed the classroom again toward my target.
“Kuzuhara Kazuma! Are you trying to seduce even Himeno?! You’re a despicable scumbag! As long as I’m here, I won’t let you!”
“Hey, Ijuuin, I need to talk.”
I stopped right in front of the agitated Ijuuin and spoke.
“Don’t you want cosplay photos of Setsuna and Arisa? Fresh, super rare ones that will never hit the market.”
Ijuuin’s eyes widened in surprise at my words.
“Cosplay…?”
“Yes. I’ll take cosplay photos of Setsuna and Arisa. You can have your favorite costumes on the double centers of ‘Damenzu.’ Not a bad deal, right?”
“If that’s possible… I’m sure you can make them do it since you’ve brainwashed them…!”
She tried to deny it but quickly twisted her face and admitted it.
Watching our relationship from afar, she probably understood I could persuade them to wear the costumes she wanted. And that was true.
“That’s right. Brainwashing is a big misunderstanding, but making them wear costumes is easy for me. So, what do you say?”
“...You’re not the type to offer this without a plan, right? What are you scheming?”
Ijuuin glared suspiciously, but I had no scheme.
“Scheming is the wrong word. I just find it annoying to be bothered by your fan club all the time. I was fed up with waiting for me this morning. I just want a mutually beneficial truce.”
“A truce? What? You should just free Setsuna and Arisa! They have the potential to soar worldwide! You, a scumbag, monopolizing them is unforgivable!”
“Enough with the big talk. I don’t like it either, but I just want you to stop interfering so much and keep your distance.”
I stopped Ijuuin from arguing. This deal was to avoid trouble.
I honestly just wanted her to listen.
“In return, I’ll give you the photos. It’s a win-win deal. What do you say?”
I thought it was a good deal. If she stopped bothering me, she’d get rare cosplay photos of her favorite idols in her favorite costumes.
Most idol otaku collect goods as a hobby.
Some even risk everything for handshake events. Opportunities to have their favorite idols wear costumes they want are almost nonexistent.
If they got that chance, it’d be heaven for fans, satisfying their approval needs and fetishes.
No idol otaku would refuse.
Especially a runaway heiress who transferred just to be near her favorite idols.
So I made the offer to Ijuuin, but…
“Don’t underestimate me.”
With a strong, determined gaze, Ijuuin glared at me.

“Who do you think I am? Ijuuin Reika, sole daughter of the Ijuuin conglomerate and ‘Dimension Stars!’ fan club No. 007! As a single-digit number member, I have pride and honor. Unlike you, who tries to exploit idols, I won’t be lured by such lowly tactics and bait!”
“So you’re saying you won’t accept this deal?”

“Of course not! Getting photos this way would set a bad example for other fan club members! I won’t allow such methods! Above all, using those girls for your selfish desires is outrageous! Shame on you!”
She cut me off, condemning my methods.
Her eyes showed no hesitation, revealing her pride as a wealthy heiress and a ‘Damenzu’ fan.
“I see. That’s a shame…”
I sighed softly. I might have underestimated Ijuuin.
I thought she’d jump at the offer, so this resistance was unexpected.
Persuasion would probably be useless. Her will was that strong.
“Hmph, do you understand now, Kuzuhara Kazuma? Your dirty tricks won’t work on me…”
“Well then, what about the others? Don’t you want cosplay photos like Ijuuin?”
So, I decided to stop wasting time.
I quickly gave up on Ijuuin and turned to the boys in class.
“Huh?”
“Is that okay!?”
“Yeah. But stop bothering me. And don’t follow Ijuuin. She doesn’t want it, so if you side with her, no photos for you.”
“Of course, Kazuma-san! We’ll ignore everything she says!”
Good, great reaction. Pleased with my classmates’ sudden support, I continued.
“Okay, what do you want?”
“Waitress outfit, please! With a big smile and a pose!”
“China dress, serving style! Hair in a chignon, looking brightly this way!”
“I want a maid! Arms crossed, ‘What are you looking at, idiot?’ with a condescending look! With garter belts!”
“You idiot! Cheerleader is supreme! Just imagining Setsuna holding pom-poms and cheering makes me… ugh!”
“Competitive swimsuit! Please! I’ll pay anything! I’ll do anything!!!”
“Naked shirt, cuddling with me! If it’s Setsuna and Arisa, I’m totally fine! I’ll even go first! Give me a shy version too!!!”
“Wait, wait. That’s too many requests. Someone write down everyone’s desired outfits and situations, with names. Also, I’ll reject anything too extreme, so understand that.”
“Understood, Kazuma-san! You’re a god! Thank you!!!”
Heh, you guys are honest about your desires. But I don’t dislike that.
“Hey! W-wait!”
While I nodded satisfied with their reactions, Ijuuin suddenly looked panicked.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8BVT2kd.jpeg
“Everyone, what are you saying!? This is a trap! It’s obviously Kazuma Kuzuhara’s scheme, so why are you trying to fall for it!?”
“Well, even if you say that, chances like this don’t come around often.”
“I’m a fan club member too, but not with a single-digit number. Still, I really want to see Setsuna-chan in her favorite outfit.”
“Sorry, Ijuuin-san. I just can’t help but want to see Arisa-chan in a maid outfit! For that, I don’t care if I’m a scumbag or a devil—I’d even sell my soul!”
“Yeah, Kuzuhara’s annoying, but you can’t fight desire.”
“Sad but true, we’re just ordinary idol otaku.”
“Th-That can’t be...!”
Betrayed by those she thought were on her side, Ijuuin’s voice trembled. She must have been really shocked. I gently tapped her shoulder from behind.
“Tough luck, Ijuuin.”
“K-Kazuma Kuzuhara...”
“Well, that’s how it is. Sorry, but it seems everyone’s on my side. I can’t waste everyone’s goodwill, so I’m going to go ahead and do the cosplay photoshoot during the next break.”

“Looks like you’re not needed, so it can’t be helped. I’ll tell everyone in class not to give any photos to Ijuuin, okay? Just because you’re a zaibatsu heiress doesn’t mean you’ll snatch photos from classmates, right? You said you have the pride of a single-digit fan club member, unlike me. I’m counting on you.”
After tapping her shoulder once more and giving a thorough warning, I turned on my heel to return to my seat.
“...Mase.”
“Hm?”
For some reason, this time Ijuuin’s hand rested on my shoulder. It trembled slightly, as if she was struggling with something inside.
“I-I... I would also like... if you could give me... the photos... please...”
“Hmm? What’s that? Did I mishear? I think I just heard something impossible.”
I played dumb, and the hand on my shoulder shook violently. But it soon settled, replaced by a trembling voice from behind.
“Please, I beg you, give me the photos of the two of them...!”
Hearing that, I smiled faintly to hide the amusement I felt toward the pleading heiress.
“Oh? You were so full of bluster just now. Was that all a lie? You said you were different from me. What happened to the pride of a single-digit fan club member?”
“I was just stubborn in front of everyone... but the truth is, I want them. I want them so badly...! No matter if I’m single-digit or not, I want what I want!”
Heh, she’s fallen. They say if you want to shoot the general, first shoot the horse. Hearing the heiress’s agonized sobs, I opened my mouth, savoring the delight.
“Then, first you have something to say to me, right?”
“Ugh... I apologize for all my rudeness until now. So please...!”
“You mean ‘please,’ right?”
“...P-Please...”
“And Kazuma-sama?”
“Please, Kazuma-sama...! Please, please give me the photos of the two of them, the cosplay...!”
No matter how much money someone has, no one can resist their desires. Even a zaibatsu heiress is no exception.

“Ku ku ku, if you say it that much, I guess I have no choice... But just so you know, there won’t be a next time. And all the costume and camera costs are on you. Accepting that kind of penalty is only natural, right?”
“Of course...! Ugh, ugh...!”
Satisfied with that certainty, I responded generously to Ijuuin, who showed sincere regret while letting out frustrated groans.
